Coreweaving

A conversational assistant for Weave documentation questions that need more than one page. It chooses when to search, read another page, run a small Python example or draft an answer. It remembers follow-ups and checks answers against the documents and the user's question. The assignment's agent tracing, online Signals and weave.Evaluation with 13 varied cases and an AI judge are implemented. Traces record what happened; Signals review selected completed answers; evaluations test the assistant on known questions.

Public Weave project · Brief and implementation · Experiments and findings · Decisions and screenshots · Code map · Evidence archive

Start here

Install uv. You need a funded Anthropic API account, Anthropic and W&B/Forge keys, a Weave project, and access to Opus 5.5. Docker enables the optional offline Python tool.

Clone and install. This installs the locked dependencies; it makes no model requests.
git clone https://github.com/devsodhirao/coreweaving.git
cd coreweaving
uv sync --frozen
cp .env.example .env
chmod 600 .env

Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, WANDB_API_KEY and WEAVE_PROJECT=your-team/your-project in .env. The measured configuration uses claude-opus-5-5 for AGENT_MODEL, VERIFIER_MODEL and JUDGE_MODEL; existing environment settings override defaults. The agent and verifier request medium effort; the offline judge uses provider-default effort.

Restore the documentation. Expected: 351 pages restored and checked against the manifest. This uses the bundled archive, with no model requests.
uv run python scripts/fetch_docs.py --locked --weave-only
Run the app. Expected: the chat opens at http://127.0.0.1:8501. Loading the page makes no model requests; submitting a question uses API credits.
uv run streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

Full regression on the presentation build

Current runtime: a07e5da, source b312a2c9a081. The unchanged 13-case regression completed with 12/13 judge-recorded case passes and 47/48 assertions. All 13 cases have valid grades. This is one complete run after a separately preserved operationally failed attempt, not a completion view combining selected quality results.

Measure	Observed result
Cases / assertions	12/13 cases; 47/48 assertions; zero ungraded assertions
Engine time	Median 31.46 seconds across all 15 turns; range 10.24–70.99 seconds
Requests	97 returned agent model responses, including 23 audits; 13 evaluation judge responses
Returned-usage estimate	$5.2549468 for this complete run; no unpriced calls in this run
Source checks	64 stored section occurrences match saved page hashes and expected text, counting reuse; no citation-format or Python-syntax issues
Local mechanics	430 tests passed on these same runtime bytes; the existing receipt is reused rather than relabeled as a new test run

The earlier timeout attempt adds $0.24075 in known usage plus one unpriced judge request. Combined known use is $5.4956968, with that unknown charge still unresolved. Estimates exclude Signals, hosting, taxes and unreturned charges. Engine time excludes offline judging, browser rendering and run setup.

Readback matches all 15 turn roots, 97 agent responses and 13 indexed evaluation rows with their judge receipts. The demo readiness check confirms the same runtime files on port 8501, stopped previews and clean desktop/mobile welcome and About screens.

What failed, and why it matters
